name: Get Leads by List ID
summary: Pulls all leads that are members of a specific static list.
whenToUse: When you want the members of one static list. Find the list ID by opening the list in Marketo and looking at the number in its URL.

path.name: listId
path.label: Static list ID
path.hint: The numeric ID of the static list (visible in the Marketo UI URL when you open the list).

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Pick which fields to include. If you pick none, Marketo returns only the basics: id, email, first name, last name, and created/updated dates.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Lead records in the list, up to 300 per page. 'moreResult' + 'nextPageToken' indicate more pages.

notes: For large lists (thousands of members), a Bulk Extract of the static list is the better tool (Phase 4).
